pages.title: Directionality
pages.text: 0% emits equally in every direction. 100% applies the full forward cone and rear attenuation. Aim the speaker front toward listeners; directionality does not extend range.

pages.title: Cone and rear volume
pages.text: Cone angle sets the width of the forward area. Rear attenuation reduces volume outside it; 100% silences the rear at full Directionality. At 0% Directionality, both are ignored.

pages.title: Area preview
pages.text: The preview lasts eight seconds. Teal marks the boundary; green indicates louder areas and amber quieter areas. It uses the current range, fade and directional settings.
